title.narrative: EU4Peace II ¿ Professional Media, Practitioners and Grassroots joining Forces for Peace

description.narrative: Contract related to: EU4Peace II ¿ Professional Media, Practitioners and Grassroots joining Forces for Peace - Since December 2021, the President of the European Council (PEC) Charles Michel and European Union Special Representative for the South Caucasus and the Crisis in Georgia (EUSR) Toivo Klaar have been leading the EU¿s efforts to mediate a peaceful conflict settlement between Armenia and Azerbaijan through a series of high-level peace talks. However, the situation on the ground remains very tense, and the recent escalations in September 2022 highlight the continuing fragility. As emphasised by President Michel at the August meeting, it is now key to ensure participation from within both countries¿ societies in the peace process. The EU¿s decade-long partnerships with practitioners on the ground, make it uniquely placed to engage on both political and societal levels. The activities foreseen include mobilising existing and new networks of experts, community groups, etc. to discuss key issues and provide recommendations for the formal peace process, support an expanded media space (with a variety of media types and genres) for a moderate and less polarised public discussion of peace process outcomes and a rapid response mechanism providing flexible, swift support to needs and requests emanating from the formal negotiations
